stable.notes:
Hibiscus 0.8.27 fixes a license recovery problem that could affect customers updating from older signed builds.

- An existing Mac is no longer mistaken for a new device when its legacy Keychain item is temporarily unavailable.
- Paid licenses affected by duplicate device seats from Hibiscus 0.8.11–0.8.16 can now recover safely by activating again with the original license key.
- Normal two-Mac seat limits and verified device management remain unchanged.
